channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Governo Lula reserva R$ 98 bi para crédito subsidiado em 2027, e custo para dívida pode chegar a R$ 20,5 bi
item.description: The Lula administration allocated R$97.9 billion for subsidized credit in 2027, with a debt cost of R$20.5 billion. The measure aims to expand low-cost loans for strategic sectors. The budget proposal was submitted on Monday.

item.title: Votação da MP que zera a ‘taxa das blusinhas’ é adiada para terça
item.description: The vote on the MP eliminating the 'blusinhas tax' was postponed to Tuesday for adjustments to Senator Leila Barros' report. The measure, which removes import duties on purchases up to $50, must be approved by September 8th to remain valid. The bill received 112 amendments and will proceed to the Chamber of Deputies after the mixed committee.

item.title: Lula recebe banqueiros e empresários no Palácio da Alvorada
item.description: Lula hosted bankers and businessmen at Alvorada Palace during a dinner arranged by the Finance Minister and PT leader, aiming to strengthen ties with the economic sector.

item.title: A surpresa em decisão de ministra do TSE contra campanha de Lula
item.description: TSE minister Estela Aranha decided to suspend a campaign ad by Lula that accused Flávio Bolsonaro of being a ghost worker. The decision was seen as surprising since she was considered close to the government. According to VEJA's political editor, the move signals the judge's independence.

item.title: Orçamento 2027 calcula Bolsa Família sem reajuste
item.description: The federal government does not project an adjustment for Bolsa Família in 2027, maintaining the minimum benefit at R$600 per family. The budget projects R$157.1 billion for the program, below the amounts for 2026 and 2025. Additionally, fiscal restrictions will limit public servant adjustments to 0.6% above inflation.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro nas pesquisas para presidente: veja pontuação do candidato
item.description: Recent polls show Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) experiencing vote intention fluctuations for 2026, with variations between first and second round scenarios. Surveys reveal the candidate's positioning across different electoral contexts.

item.title: Aporte não é Pix de R$ 6 bilhões aos Correios, diz ministro do Planejamento
item.description: Minister of Planning Bruno Moretti stated that the R$ 6 billion injection into Correios requires counterparts, dismissing the notion of a Pix transfer. He emphasized the need for structured measures to ensure the postal service's stability.

item.title: Surpresa em pesquisas, Cury ganha quase 2,5 mi de seguidores em 1 semana
item.description: Presidential candidate Augusto Cury (Avante) is leading in polls and gained nearly 2.5 million Instagram followers in one week, according to the content shared.

item.title: Augusto Cury nas pesquisas para presidente: veja qual a pontuação do candidato
item.description: Recent polls for the 2026 presidency show Augusto Cury (Avante) with low scores in the first round, remaining outside the main debate. The candidate maintains gradual performance without significant variation in voting intentions.

item.title: Aliados de Lula dizem que percepção sobre preços e dívidas é risco maior que Lulinha na eleição
item.description: Lula's allies assess that voter perception on prices and debt poses a bigger reelection risk than allegations involving one of his sons in an alleged lobby for drug sales to the Ministry of Health. The election is expected to be driven by economic concerns and family scandal influence.

item.title: André Esteves, do BTG, se encontra com Donald Trump nos EUA para falar de Brasil
item.description: André Estives of BTG Pactual met with Donald Trump in the US to discuss Brazil's and Latin America's economy in a 45-minute meeting. The encounter takes place amid efforts to resume negotiations between Brazil and the US over trade tariffs, following a phone call between Lula and Trump the previous week.

item.title: Tesouro tem maior emissão de títulos ligados à Selic em 20 anos
item.description: The National Treasury revised the Annual Financing Plan (PAF) to increase the issuance of public bonds linked to the Selic rate, reaching 48.2% of total issuance in 2026, the highest level in 20 years. This shift increases government exposure to Central Bank interest rate decisions but reduces investor risk by decreasing sensitivity to long-term interest rate fluctuations.

item.title: TSE começa compilação, assinatura digital e lacração de sistemas eleitorais
item.description: The TSE began compiling, digitally signing, and sealing the electoral systems for the 2026 elections, ensuring the integrity and security of the software used in voting machines. By September 3rd, the code components are gathered; on September 4th, the official sealing ceremony will take place. Oversight entities monitor the process to ensure transparency.

item.title: Governo Lula quer adiar compensação pelo fim da taxa das blusinhas
item.description: The Lula government decided to postpone compensation to the domestic industry for the import tax exemption on purchases up to $50, including the measure in an MP that ends the 'blusinhas tax'. The Treasury will assess economic impacts every 6 months, proposing corrective measures if there are losses to the sector.

item.title: Governo Lula eleva em 33% o custo do desfile de 7 de Setembro
item.description: The Lula administration increased the 2026 Independence Day parade budget by 33.2%, from R$4.31 million in 2025 to R$5.74 million. The same event company has been contracted since 2024, but the contract scope expanded to include planning and oversight. In an election year, the ceremony is expected to be more modest to avoid scrutiny from the electoral court.

item.title: Aliados de Pacheco esperam votação de seu nome para o TCU na quarta (2/9)
item.description: Allies of Rodrigo Pacheco expect a vote on his TCU nomination on Wednesday following Bruno Dantas's resignation. The choice, supported by Davi Alcolumbre, ends speculation about the former Senate president's future, who may assume the role until age 75.

item.title: Augusto Cury atrai eleitor cansado de polarização e faz o papel que tiveram Marina, Ciro e Tebet, diz analista
item.description: Augusto Cury experienced a surge in polls, jumping from 0% to 8% in voting intentions, placing third behind Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The candidate attracts voters tired of polarization, taking on a role similar to Marina, Ciro, and Tebet in previous elections. His week included a presidential debate and interviews with major media outlets.

item.title: Seis meses de guerra no Irã asfixiam agronegócio e encarecem os alimentos no Brasil
item.description: Six months of war in Iran negatively impact Brazil's agribusiness, increasing food costs due to dependency on imported inputs like fertilizers. The conflict also affects global leaders' popularity, including Donald Trump.

item.title: TSE inicia preparação e compilação dos sistemas eleitorais das eleições de 2026
item.description: The TSE began on Monday (31) the preparation of electoral systems for the 2026 elections, focusing on program compilation until September 3. This phase involves gathering codes and components to generate official system versions, ensuring protection against modifications. The stage will conclude on September 4 with the Digital Signature and Sealing Ceremony of the Electoral Systems, guaranteeing the integrity of the software used in the electoral process.

item.title: Derrite diz que Carbono Oculto foi operação feita por SP
item.description: Guilherme Derrite (PP) claimed the Carbono Oculto operation was run by São Paulo state and criticized the PT for attributing it to the federal government. He highlighted crackdowns on organized crime, including the Cracolândia operation, as achievements of his administration, accusing opponents of using the operation in electoral campaigns. Derrite praised Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) for cooperation in reclaiming territory.

item.title: “Atacar o Judiciário é atacar o pobre”, diz Toffoli
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Dias Toffoli stated that attacking the judiciary is attacking the poor, emphasizing the importance of judicial independence at the Electoral Law Congress in Rio de Janeiro. He highlighted the role of the STF in protecting vulnerable citizens.

item.title: 10 anos depois, precisamos seguir gritando: foi golpe, sim
item.description: The author asserts that the 2016 coup against Dilma Rousseff was indeed a coup, and emphasizes the importance of continuing to warn about threats to Brazilian democracy. He highlights the need for civic resistance and historical memory to confront challenges to democratic institutions.

item.title: Alckmin diz que Brasil manterá negociação com EUA para reverter tarifaço
item.description: Vice-president Geraldo Alckmin stated Brazil will continue negotiating with the US to reduce tariffs, as directed by Lula. The government aims to discuss topics like the Redat project and critical minerals to attract investments.

item.title: Candidatos já receberam R$ 139 milhões de pessoas físicas; veja os maiores doadores
item.description: By March 31, candidates for the 2026 elections had received over R$139 million in campaign donations from individuals, according to TSE data. The largest donors include entrepreneurs and lawyers, such as Alexandre Grendene Bartelle (R$3 million), Fabiano Silveira (R$2 million), and Carlos Eduardo Ferraz (R$1.5 million). These donations reflect resource concentration among influential figures in the national political landscape.

item.title: Governo Lula exige água gratuita em grandes eventos
item.description: The Lula administration reinstates the requirement for free drinking water at events with over one thousand attendees, both public and private. The measure aims to ensure hydration access and protect participants' health. The new rule takes effect on August 31, 2026.

item.title: Por que Augusto Cury cresceu nas pesquisas, de acordo com a sua campanha
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) saw a significant rise in polls, from 2% to 11% in Nexus/BTG and 3% to 7,8% in AtlasIntel, following greater media exposure, including the first presidential debate and an interview on TV Globo. The campaign attributes the increase to expanded voter awareness, boosted by free electoral time slots and social media growth, with opponents suspecting artificial amplification.

item.title: Setembro de 2026 terá feriado nacional em uma 2ª feira
item.description: Brazil will have a national holiday on September 7, 2026, celebrating Independence Day. Workers who do not work on weekends will enjoy three consecutive days off, while those who must work on the date are entitled to double pay or compensatory leave. The holiday ends a nearly three-month period without national holidays.

item.title: Renan Santos: Brasil tem cenário de ‘forte despolitização’ e crescimento de Cury foi ‘inorgânico’
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate from Mission to the Presidency, criticized the inorganic growth of Augusto Cury in polls, attributing it to strong depoliticization of voters. He minimized the TSE decision regarding his registration and defended harsh economic measures, such as restrictions on consigned credit and a proposal to ban betting.

item.title: Caiado promete cortes, mas diz que não pode detalhar plano porque dados públicos são 'manipulados'
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) promises fiscal cuts by targeting supersalaries, budget amendments and subsidies, but claims he cannot detail the plan due to manipulated public data. In an interview with TV Jovem Pan, Caiado highlighted his management experience in Goiás and pledged to conduct an audit to identify areas to be cut if elected.

item.title: Eleições 2026: veja os candidatos aos governos de todos os estados e do DF
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections feature 199 gubernatorial candidates across 26 states and the Federal District. The first round is scheduled for October 4, with a potential second round on October 25. Candidates are categorized as 'Running' (approved) or 'Ineligible' (rejected or pending judicial review).

item.title: Damares aciona a Justiça contra ministro de Lula por vídeo com “13”
item.description: Senator Damares Alves filed a lawsuit against the Ministry of the CGU, Vinicius Marques de Carvalho, over an institutional video released in partnership with the TSE. The lawsuit questions the legality of the content addressing electoral system oversight. The case involves discussions on transparency and influence of figures associated with President Lula.

item.title: O que os eleitores de Augusto Cury pensam de Lula e de Flávio Bolsonaro na área econômica
item.description: Augusto Cury surged in the latest BTG Pactual/Nexus poll, rising from 2% to 11% in first-round voting intentions, taking third place. Among Cury voters, Flávio Bolsonaro is preferred over Lula on five of six topics assessed, including areas traditionally strong for the PT such as healthcare and poverty reduction. The absence of Lula and Flávio from the first presidential debate may have boosted Cury's rise, though his voter base could be decisive in a potential runoff between the two frontrunners.

item.title: Renan Santos participa de sabatina de VEJA nesta segunda-feira
item.description: Presidential candidate Renan Santos from Missão participates in a debate organized by VEJA on Monday, the 31st, live at 7 PM via VEJA+ TV, the magazine website, and YouTube. The interview, hosted by Marcela Rahal with Robson Bonin and José Benedito, will address his proposals and positions on key campaign issues.

item.title: X aponta lacunas em regra do TSE sobre exclusão de candidatos de algoritmo e pede suspensão
item.description: X (formerly Twitter) flagged gaps in a TSE rule requiring social media platforms to exclude candidate-declared profiles from content recommendation systems during election campaigns, requesting the suspension of the provision. The criticism questions the technical and legal feasibility of the rule.

item.title: Pesquisa mostra como Augusto Cury se sai entre jovens, mulheres e eleitores de alta renda
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) reached 11% of voting intentions in the BTG Pactual/Nexus poll, showing strong performance among young people (22%), women (13%) and high-income voters (13%). The candidate rose nine points in one week, now holding third place behind Lula (39%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (33%). His support is higher among college-educated voters (17%) and decreases progressively with age.

item.title: Augusto Cury desponta como fenômeno do ‘centro comportamental’, mas ainda precisa ser testado
item.description: Augusto Cury emerges as a 'behavioral center' phenomenon, attracting voters averse to polarization and drawn to personal growth and anti-establishment discourse. Despite rapid polling gains and high positivity, his image slightly worsened after Jornal Nacional exposure, increasing fear and wariness. His main challenge will be maintaining his outsider appeal under greater scrutiny as a concrete presidential candidate.

item.title: Avanço de Cury revela uma sociedade que não quer só governo, mas ajuda emocional
item.description: Augusto Cury, a self-help author, emerges as a third-way candidate in the 2026 elections despite proposing exotic and disconnected solutions to the country's structural issues. His ideas, such as a Ministry of AI and influencers in embassies, reflect society's desire for emotional support and quick fixes. His rise in polls shows a connection to a growing demand for self-awareness and well-being.

item.title: Atlas: 67% têm imagem negativa de Renan Santos, pior resultado entre presidenciáveis
item.description: An AtlasIntel survey reveals that 67% of voters hold a negative image of Renan Santos (Missão), the worst result among presidential candidates. Only 16% consider his image positive, according to polling of 5,014 voters between August 22 and 27. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) ranks second with the worst negative image at 60%.

item.title: Câmara deve decidir sobre "taxa das blusinhas" nesta segunda
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies is set to vote on Monday on MP 1.357/2026, known as the 'blusinhas tax', which eliminates the 20% import tax on international online purchases up to $50. If approved, the measure moves to the Senate and must be finalized by September 8 to remain valid. The government supports the tax cut as beneficial to popular consumption, while the National Confederation of Industry argues it creates unfair competition from imports.

item.title: O que explica a ascensão de Augusto Cury nas pesquisas eleitorais
item.description: Augusto Cury, presidential candidate from Avante, saw a sharp rise in polls, jumping from 2% to 11% in BTG/Nexus and reaching 7.8% in AtlasIntel, following a week of intense media exposure. His growth stems from a TV debate appearance and prior public recognition as an author and psychiatrist, enabling a swift political rebranding.

item.title: JOTA Principal | Congresso tem último ‘esforço concentrado’ antes do primeiro turno
item.description: Congress enters its final concentrated push before the first electoral round, with votes expected on the MP for the 'blusinhas' tax and slow progress on key PECs such as Public Security and the end of the 6×1 shift schedule. The Redat and critical minerals bills are also under review but lack clear consensus. Recent polls show unusual movement in the electoral race.

item.title: Após furar bolha, Cury mira eleitor que desanimou da política, diz marqueteiro
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) reached 11% and 7.8% in voter intention polls, boosted by debates. Campaign strategist Sérgio Lima emphasized targeting disillusioned voters and moving beyond polarization.

item.title: Potencial de voto de Lula é de 49%, aponta pesquisa Nexus
item.description: A new Nexus/BTG Pactual poll shows President Lula (PT) leading first-round voting intentions for the 2026 election with 39%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 33%. Lula's voting potential is 49%, while Flávio's is 47%. The poll also reveals that 50% of respondents would not vote for Flávio under any circumstances, compared to 49% who say the same about Lula.

item.title: TSE começa a julgar registros de Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro e outros candidatos à Presidência
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court began on Monday, the 31st, the analysis of the first requests for registration of candidacies for the 2026 presidential elections, with rulings scheduled until September 2nd. Among the first candidates to be analyzed are Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Flávio Bolsonaro, Romeu Zema and Geraldo Alckmin. The processes also examine the regularity of party acts and the compliance of submitted documents.

item.title: Damares aciona Justiça contra ministro de Lula por vídeo da CGU que sinaliza voto no 13
item.description: Senator Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF) filed a lawsuit against the CGU minister, Vinícius Marques de Carvalho, over a video signaling a vote for the PT. The CGU claimed the image is illustrative and the TSE requested the post's removal.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest testa 2º turno entre Lula e Augusto Cury
item.description: A new Quaest poll projects a second-round matchup between Lula and Augusto Cury, with a margin of error of two percentage points. Lula leads voter intentions, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro and other candidates. The survey also examines various direct matchups involving the PT candidate.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta segunda-feira (31)
item.description: On March 31, the presidential candidates’ agenda is marked by debates, town halls, and meetings with voters and key economic sectors across São Paulo, the South of Brazil, and Porto Alegre. Ronaldo Caião leads with intense meetings with entities like Anfavea and SindusCon-SP, while Augusto Cury and Hertz Dias focus on grassroots outreach. Five candidates, including Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, have not released their schedules.

item.title: Lula vai jantar com 15 empresários em Brasília em busca de sinalizar responsabilidade fiscal
item.description: Lula meets with 15 business leaders in Brasília to signal fiscal responsibility in case of re-election. The meeting, organized by Dario Durigan, aims to reinforce commitment to fiscal adjustment and a fiscal surplus target of 0.5% of GDP.

item.title: Credores acusam Roberta Luchsinger de calote e cobram dívidas
item.description: Creditors file lawsuits against Roberta Luchsinger, a lobbyist and friend of President Lula's son, accusing her of defaulting on old debts. The case raises concerns about political influence and potential irregularities in lobbying activities.

item.title: Contas de Zema em MG têm melhora, mas caixa segue negativo e renúncias disparam
item.description: Zema's administration in Minas Gerais shows improvement in fiscal indicators, but public cash flow remains negative. Budget renunciations surged, while debt renegotiation with the federal government provides temporary relief.
